bugs.description: The first handler sets the key-specific audit type on a clone. Later handlers clone the original nonempty user and replace the audit user with a session type, losing account/organization key attribution.
bugs.evidence: Inspect key branch and both later setUser calls; treat both sites as one defect.

appwrite-appwrite-11717.exclusion: The empty-pool fallback already exists in the merge-base. A later fix is not proof that this PR introduced it.

bugs.description: The app and web create actions accept and normalize platformId, then discard it and store a fresh random ID. Clients cannot create or subsequently address the requested ID.
bugs.evidence: New App/Create.php and Web/Create.php construct $id with ID::unique() instead of the normalized parameter; count once across both endpoints.

bugs.description: The watch rebuild callback exposes file-name strings in outputs, while its public BuildOutput contract requires BuildArtifact objects. Consumers reading artifact.path or Blob methods fail.
bugs.evidence: onDevServerBuildComplete constructs string array and passes it as outputs; packages/bun-types/bun.d.ts BuildOutput requires BuildArtifact[].

bugs.description: The middleware writes x-current-path to response headers, but server-side auth reads request headers. The newly added preservation of the deep-link destination therefore does not reach its consumer.

bugs.description: Config accepts a 121-byte harness key, but the newly added report attribution rejects values over 120 bytes. Valid configuration therefore produces reviews that fail validation.
bugs.evidence: Config.Validate checks the key pattern but only bounds h.Model; report attribution bounds all values; engine stamps the harness key into reports.
